start: An owner with no PIN yet, on the sign-in page with a one-time code made on another device where an owner is signed in

steps.action: Type the mobile number and the one-time code, sign in
user_sees: A sheet titled 'Set your own PIN' over Today
'Save your own PIN. Next time, sign in with your mobile number and this PIN. You won’t need a code from the owner.'
Boxes 'Choose a 6-digit PIN' and 'Type the PIN again'; hint 'You sign in with your mobile number and this PIN. Keep it private.'
Buttons 'Not now' and 'Save my PIN'
must_not: The sheet shown to someone who signed in with a PIN
The digits shown in clear
Every other open tab of the panel reloading because the prompt was remembered

steps.action: Type the same 6 digits in both boxes, tap 'Save my PIN'
user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…'
The sheet closes; a note for 3 seconds: 'PIN saved. Next time, sign in with your mobile number and this PIN.'
must_not: Two saves from two taps
The note staying on screen
The sheet opening again after the save

steps.action: Sign out, sign in with the mobile number and the new PIN
user_sees: Today opens; no PIN sheet
must_not: The PIN refused
The sheet asked a second time on this device

start: An owner who already has a PIN (forgot it) and signs in with a one-time code made on another device where an owner is signed in

steps.action: Sign in with the one-time code
user_sees: A sheet titled 'Choose a new PIN?'
'You signed in with a one-time code. If you forgot your PIN, choose a new one now.'
Buttons 'Keep my old PIN' and 'Save my PIN'; no box for the current PIN
must_not: The 'Set your own PIN' wording for someone who has a PIN
A box asking for the forgotten PIN

steps.action: Type a new PIN twice, tap 'Save my PIN' within 15 minutes of signing in
user_sees: 'New PIN saved. Next time, sign in with your mobile number and this PIN.'
must_not: The old PIN still working
The save refused inside the 15 minutes

steps.action: Do the same, but leave the sheet open for more than 15 minutes before saving
user_sees: A plain message why it was not saved and what to do
must_not: A silent failure
The new PIN saved without the old one after the 15 minutes are over

start: An owner on the 'Set your own PIN' sheet

steps.action: Type two different PINs, tap 'Save my PIN'
user_sees: 'The two PINs are not the same. Type the same PIN in both boxes.'
must_not: A PIN saved
The sheet closing

steps.action: Type letters, then fewer than 6 digits, then the last 6 digits of the own mobile number
user_sees: Letters are not taken; a plain reason for a short or easy PIN
must_not: A PIN shorter than 6 digits saved
The last 6 digits of the mobile accepted as the PIN

steps.action: Tap 'Save my PIN' after another owner signed this device out
user_sees: A plain message, then the sign-in page
must_not: The sheet stuck on Saving…
A PIN saved for a signed-out device

steps.action: Sign in with a one-time code in a browser that blocks storage (private mode)
user_sees: No PIN sheet; Today opens
must_not: An error page
A sheet that returns on every page

start: An owner with no PIN, just signed in with a one-time code, sheet 'Set your own PIN' open

steps.action: Reload the page before answering
user_sees: The sheet again
must_not: The prompt lost by a reload before any answer

steps.action: Tap 'Not now' (or close the sheet)
user_sees: The sheet goes; Today stays
must_not: A PIN saved
A sign-out

steps.action: Reload, then sign out and sign in again with a PIN-less code on another day
user_sees: No sheet after the reload; after a new code sign-in the sheet is offered once more
must_not: The sheet returning on the same sign-in after 'Not now'

steps.action: Open Settings, Staff & sign-in
user_sees: A button to set the own PIN later ('Set my PIN')
must_not: No way left to set a PIN after 'Not now'

steps.action: A second person signs in with a code on the same device before the first one answered
user_sees: The sheet is for the person now signed in
must_not: The first person's PIN changed by the second person's sheet

start: An owner saving a PIN from the prompt

steps.action: Type the PIN and tap 'Save my PIN'
user_sees: Dots in place of digits
must_not: The PIN written into the browser storage of this device
The PIN shown in the address bar, a note or an error message

steps.action: Another person of the gym opens Staff & sign-in
user_sees: Whether this person has a PIN, never the PIN itself
must_not: The PIN or any part of it readable by the owner or anyone else
